items.issue: Beat tagged with poi_name='Marais', but Marais is a neighborhood/Area, not a POI. Per Schema v3 the Marais should be modelled as an Area node with WITHIN containment, not as a POI.
items.recommended_action: Re-tag to a more specific POI within the Marais (e.g., place des Vosges, Hôtel de Sully, rue des Rosiers) based on beat content, OR attach to a Marais Area node when Area infrastructure is in scope. Until resolved, this beat will not route to any POI.
